dedupe_keys.name: ipde panama geoservicios institutional wms and wfs services of the panamanian spatial data infrastructure

description: The Panamanian spatial data infrastructure, coordinated by the national land administration authority ANATI, lists on its geoservices page the OGC web map and web feature services published by member institutions. The page read on 2026-09-28 gives service addresses for the national geographic institute (administrative limits 2018 and fundamental data 2014 at 1:25,000, map grids, and the national CORS station network of 2015), the civil aviation authority (runways and aerodromes, 2019), probable seismic losses in the housing, health and education sectors of the city of David (2012), University of Panama centres, aquaculture layers, crime incidents in Chiriquí, a district land-use plan in Panama City and border posts. Coverage is Panama. Access is free through WMS and WFS clients; the page states no licence and the footer reserves all rights. Caveats: many layers are dated single snapshots, and some services sit on test folders. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response studies, such as combining 1:25,000 base layers with the David seismic loss polygons. No related Panamanian geoservices record is catalogued.
